item.title: On Donetsk’s ‘life or death’ highway with the Khyzhak brigade – photo essay
item.summary: The road to Konstyantynivka in Donetsk, Ukraine, is a perilous journey for the Khyzhak brigade – a mobile unit tasked with shooting down Russian drones to cover soldiers’ rotations or moving armoured vehicles “Holy yeah! Yeaaaah! Done!” Booooooom. Dzhango firing to shoot down a Russian FPV-drone. Continue reading...
